sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; top Progress Advantage and RiVER were rejected from automation memory as published, so the run pivoted inside the same table to PEEU.
Main agent read the arXiv abstract, HTML full text, PDF extraction, appendix algorithm, TDHAF definitions, training settings, result tables, and ACL Anthology entry.
Article is pure Markdown with more than 5000 Chinese characters, no external image embeds, and evidence represented through tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid.
